title: Kirby Problem 4.17
exact_target: Is there a closed simply connected smooth irreducible four-manifold whose intersection form has both positive and negative indices even?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2893 (KP-4.17). CC BY 4.0.
